video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Pre Season vs Los Angeles Clippers | October 10, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on RJ Barrett's decision-making and playmaking growth
quotes.excerpt: I was really happy how quickly he was making decisions and making it easy on himself on teammates.
quotes.quote: I was really happy how quickly he was making decisions and making it easy on himself on teammates. I thought that RJ was outstanding, always in the right spot, cutting, moving. We're still getting our legs back, and you can see that, finding our conditioning, finding rhythm. So that was it in a nutshell, the game.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic praised RJ Barrett for his playmaking growth during the preseason, noting that Barrett was outstanding in his decision-making and always in the right spot.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on integrating Jakob Poeltl and Chris Boucher
quotes.excerpt: Those two guys will be sharing the court quite a bit.
quotes.quote: Those two guys will be sharing the court quite a bit. Obviously, Jakob is super important for us and brings so much value, and Chris as well. So those guys they will have to learn how to play off of each other, to understand the spacing. When those two are together on the court, we have to be dominating, rebounding, offensive and defensive.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says the Raptors need to be a dominant rebounding team when Jakob Poeltl and Chris Boucher share the floor together.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on RJ Barrett's offensive role and shooting
quotes.excerpt: He needs to shoot a lot of threes, he needs to playmake for us.
quotes.quote: He needs to shoot a lot of threes, he needs to playmake for us. He's super important for us on the ball and he's super important for us when he's off the ball. I think that he's really growing into a player that can affect the game in so many different ways.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic wants RJ Barrett to be a primary playmaker and shooter, emphasizing that Barrett is growing into a player who can affect the game in many different ways.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on injury status of Immanuel Quickley
quotes.excerpt: He's feeling better, but he's not ready to play.
quotes.quote: He's feeling better, but he's not ready to play. He just needs to go through a practice and contact before he's available for a game.
quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley is feeling better but is not yet ready to play. Darko Rajakovic says he must go through a full practice and contact before he is available for a game.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on his offensive versatility and catch-and-shoot role
quotes.excerpt: Every game is different. Some nights it might be off the dribble, today was a lot of catch and shoots.
quotes.quote: Every game is different. Some nights it might be off the dribble, today was a lot of catch and shoots. My teammates credit to my teammates, they were finding me in a lot of open spots, Scottie, RJ, Jakob. So, I take pride in being like versatile to where I can play on the ball, off the ball, defend on the ball, off the ball. Some nights it's going to be like today, a lot of catch and shoot, and I just try to make the game easy for my teammates, give them a lot of space.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says he takes pride in his versatility, noting that he is comfortable playing on or off the ball depending on what the team needs each night.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on maintaining aggression while playing with other stars
quotes.excerpt: Always got to remind yourself to stay aggressive, even when you're playing with other great players.
quotes.quote: Always got to remind yourself to stay aggressive, even when you're playing with other great players. You don't want to become so nonchalant that you're just not being aggressive on the floor. You want to make sure that you're aggressive to make the job easy for yourself and also your teammates. Just trying to be versatile and just trying to stay in attack mode.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says he has to remind himself to stay aggressive even when playing alongside other stars, adding that he is just trying to stay in attack mode.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his focus and team performance
quotes.excerpt: Just trying to help the team win and make my shots right now.
quotes.quote: Just trying to work hard, do my best, try to help the team win. I'm making my shots right now, doing, you know, in the right spots, playing defense, trying to give myself to the game for sure. Tonight was good for our team, cleaned up some things from the first game and everybody pretty much played pretty well.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says the team cleaned up some things from their first game and felt good about their overall performance tonight.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on the impact of Kawhi Leonard's return
quotes.excerpt: When Kawhi is back in the lineup, that's going to change things a little bit.
quotes.quote: When Kawhi is back in the lineup, that's going to change things a little bit. Then it will be like a little more cutting, spacing, just to make sure that he has room and then if they double just be available. We have a good team and when we play like how we played tonight, we really have a chance.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes notes that Kawhi Leonard returning to the lineup will change the Raptors spacing and cutting requirements to ensure they maximize his impact.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his comfort playing with Kawhi Leonard and others
quotes.excerpt: I've been fortunate to play with some pretty good players.
quotes.quote: I've been fortunate to play with some pretty good players. I've played with some pretty good players, Jalen, Shai, you know, Zion. I've been fortunate to play with some pretty good players. Especially in this system, being able to step up when I need to or find different ways just to help in the flow of the offense and then defensively as well. I just try to pick my spots, whatever the team needs that night.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says he feels fortunate to have played with elite talent throughout his career, which helps him understand how to pick his spots within the flow of the offense.
